items.title: Curvature-Guided Module Localization for Low-Rank Detoxification of Backdoored Large Language Models
items.summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to large language models (LLMs) by causing otherwise benign systems to produce attacker-specified malicious behavior when a hidden trigger is present. In this work, we study post hoc detoxification of backdoored LLMs in a practical setting where the defender has access to the poisoned model but does not wish to retrain the full network from scratch. We propose a mechanistically guided weight-space repair framework that first localizes modules involved in propagating trigger-induced behavior using activation patching and Fisher/K-FAC curvature analysis, and then applies targeted low-rank repair to only the most influential modules. We evaluate the method on poisoned variants of \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} with triggers inserted at the beginning, middle, and end of otherwise benign prompts. Results show that the proposed approach substantially suppresses trigger-conditioned malicious responses while preserving benign model behavior. These findings suggest that backdoor removal in LLMs can be formulated as a localized structural repair problem rather than only a broad behavioral alignment problem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）面临的后门攻击威胁，即攻击者在模型中植入隐蔽触发器，使模型在遇到特定输入时产生恶意行为。作者聚焦于实际防御场景：防御者拥有被污染的模型，但不想从头重新训练。他们提出一种机制引导的权重空间修复框架，首先利用激活修补（activation patching）和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析定位与触发器行为传播相关的模块，然后仅对最关键的模块进行针对性低秩修复。实验在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct模型上评估，将触发器植入良性提示的开头、中间或结尾。结果显示，该方法能显著抑制触发器引发的恶意响应，同时保持良性的模型行为。该工作表明LLM的后门移除可以形式化为局部结构性修复问题，而非仅依赖广泛的行为对齐。适合关注LLM安全、后门防御的研究者和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种可解释、高效的LLM后门修复方法，避免全模型重训，为实际部署中的深度防御提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于其他Transformer架构模型的后门检测与修复，迁移至多模态、代码生成等场景。

items.title: AI-Generated PowerShell Malware: An Experimental Framework and Dataset
items.summary: Generative AI has emerged as a significant cybersecurity threat, with several recent attack campaigns leveraging LLMs to generate code for malicious purposes via scripting languages such as PowerShell. Consequently, for cybersecurity analysts, it is imperative to investigate the offensive capabilities of AI code generators. In this paper, we propose an experimental framework to assess LLM-generated PowerShell malware, which comprises a novel sandbox approach for dynamic analysis of AI-generated malware. Furthermore, we present a novel, manually curated dataset of real-world PowerShell malware, annotated in natural language to assist the training and evaluation of LLMs. Finally, this study evaluates permissive, open-weight LLMs adapted to PowerShell malware generation. Our results reveal a high degree of similarity between real malware and LLM-generated ones in terms of triggered OS malicious events, with a median Jaccard index of 84.5% and 48.4% of instances achieving complete overlap.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对生成式AI（尤其是大型语言模型LLM）被用于生成恶意代码的安全威胁，提出了一个实验框架来评估LLM生成的PowerShell恶意软件。该框架包含一种新颖的沙箱方法，用于对AI生成的恶意软件进行动态分析。此外，作者构建并公开了一个手动标注的真实世界PowerShell恶意软件数据集，该数据集包含自然语言注释，可辅助LLM的训练与评估。研究评估了多个允许商用、开放权重的LLM在PowerShell恶意软件生成任务上的表现。结果显示，LLM生成的恶意软件与真实恶意软件在触发的操作系统恶意事件方面高度相似，中位Jaccard指数达到84.5%，且48.4%的实例实现了事件完全重叠。该工作揭示了AI辅助恶意软件生成的风险，并为防御方提供了检测和防范的基准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究证实了LLM可生成与真实恶意软件行为高度相似的PowerShell代码，威胁真实系统，安全团队需重新评估AI辅助攻击的风险并加强相关检测。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响包括：提升AI生成恶意软件的检测难度，可能推动攻击自动化；防御方可利用其数据集和框架改进动态分析沙箱或训练检测模型。

items.title: Security--Fidelity Tradeoffs: The Hidden Cost of Prompt Injection Defense
items.summary: We identify a security-fidelity tradeoff in defending LLMs against indirect prompt injection: defenses resist injected instructions largely by suppressing untrusted text, which corrupts tasks that must preserve it, such as translation and document editing. Attack-success metrics cannot see this, because a model that ignores an injection and one that faithfully processes it as data score identically. We introduce SecFid, a benchmark built so that executing an injection, processing it as data, and ignoring it produce distinguishable outputs. This makes fidelity measurable and exposes a frontier: across 1,168 examples and 48 configurations, no model or defense achieves both objectives. The highest-fidelity model reaches 96.5% fidelity at 47.8% security, while the most secure defenses invert this, at 99.3% security but only 71.0%-73.9% fidelity. Even defenses with identical security differ in how they earn it: some repair hijacks into faithful processing, others simply suppress benign content. A decision-theoretic analysis shows why no fixed choice can be right everywhere: the correct behavior is not a property of the defense but of the deployment, set by its relative cost of a hijack versus a dropped span. Security alone therefore measures only half of robustness, and reporting it without fidelity hides the price at which it was bought.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了防御LLM免受间接提示注入攻击时存在安全性与保真度之间的根本性权衡。传统攻击成功指标无法区分两种截然不同的行为：模型忽略注入指令（安全但可能丢失信息）与模型将注入内容作为正常数据处理（保真度高但易受攻击）。为此，作者构建了SecFid基准测试，通过设计输出可区分的任务（如翻译、文档编辑），使得执行注入、作为数据处理和忽略注入产生不同结果，从而可量化保真度。实验涵盖1168个样本和48种配置，结果表明没有模型或防御能同时实现高安全和高保真：最高保真度的模型达到96.5%保真度但仅47.8%安全，而最安全的防御将安全提升至99.3%但保真度降至71.0%-73.9%。进一步分析发现，即使安全指标相同的防御，其实现方式也不同：有的通过修复劫持让模型正确处理注入，有的则直接抑制良性内容。决策理论分析表明，不存在普适的最优选择，正确的行为取决于部署场景中劫持成本与丢弃片段的相对代价。因此，仅关注安全指标只能衡量鲁棒性的一半，忽略保真度会掩盖防御的真实代价。该研究适合LLM安全研究人员、AI系统防御者及部署LLM应用的技术团队阅读，以理解安全评估中保真度的重要性，并指导在实际场景中权衡两者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM防御中安全与保真度的矛盾，提醒安全团队不能只看安全指标，需结合任务保真度评估整体效果。决策理论分析为实际部署选择防御策略提供了理论依据。

items.title: Forensic Trajectory Signatures for Agent Memory Poisoning Detection
items.summary: We discover a behavioral invariant in LLM agents under persistent memory poisoning: in architectures where routing information is retrieved through observable memory-tool invocations, successful attacks require calling memory_recall_fact before email_send_email, a transition that non-exfiltrating sessions rarely exhibit. Under the evaluated architecture, this invariant follows from the attack's information-retrieval dependency rather than being merely an empirical correlation, and suppressing it breaks the attack. A simple rule exploiting this invariant alone achieves AUC = 0.9563. A Random Forest classifier over 19 trajectory features refines it to AUC = 0.9904 (BCa 95% CI [0.987, 0.993], N=10,000 resamples), demonstrating that the attack imprints on multiple independent behavioral channels. The signature is overdetermined: removing all recall-related features (half the feature set) leaves AUC unchanged at 0.990, confirming that memory poisoning induces a distributed trajectory signature rather than a single observable anomaly. Cross-model hold-out on 9 models (7B-120B parameters) confirms AUC = 1.000 on 6/9 hold-out splits, with all three exceptions mechanistically explained. The invariant generalizes to frontier models (GPT-4.1, GPT-4o) without retraining. A strictly prefix-only variant achieves AUC = 0.934, suggesting that real-time blocking is feasible with moderate degradation. The boundary is forensically useful: prompt-injection attacks that bypass memory produce a distinct trajectory (score = 0.541), enabling incident responders to distinguish memory-channel attacks from prompt-injection attacks using tool-call logs alone.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对LLM代理中的持久性内存中毒（memory poisoning）攻击，发现了一个行为不变性（behavioral invariant）：在通过可观察的内存工具调用来检索路由信息的架构中，成功的攻击必须在调用email_send_email之前调用memory_recall_fact，而非数据泄露会话几乎不显示此转换。这个不变性源于攻击的信息检索依赖，而非仅仅是经验相关性，并且抑制它会使攻击失效。基于此不变性的简单规则实现了AUC=0.9563；使用19个轨迹特征的随机森林分类器将AUC提升至0.9904（BCa 95% CI [0.987, 0.993]，N=10,000次重采样），表明攻击印记在多个独立的行为通道上。签名是过度确定的：移除所有与召回相关的特征（特征集的一半）后AUC仍为0.990，证实了内存中毒诱导了分布式轨迹签名而非单一可观察异常。在9个模型（7B-120B参数）上的跨模型保留测试中，6/9的保留分裂AUC=1.000，且所有三个异常均被机械地解释。该不变性可泛化到前沿模型（GPT-4.1, GPT-4o）而无需重新训练。严格仅前缀变体实现了AUC=0.934，表明实时阻断是可行的但性能有所下降。边界具有取证价值：绕过内存的提示注入攻击产生不同的轨迹（分数=0.541），使事件响应者能够仅通过工具调用日志区分内存通道攻击和提示注入攻击。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次提出基于不变量的LLM内存中毒检测方法，无需修改模型即可有效检测，且能区分攻击类型，具有高实用价值。

items.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Prompt Injection Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models Across Multilingual and Obfuscated Attack Scenarios
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly evolved, transforming industries by automating complex tasks and generating human-like content. However, as their adoption accelerates, prompt injection vulnerabilities have become increasingly apparent. Malicious actors exploit these weaknesses to generate phishing emails, deceptive websites, nd malware, posing serious security risks. This paper presents an empirical evaluation of six state-of-the-art LLMs (DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Llama, and Qwen) under diverse adversarial prompt scenarios, including direct and multi-stage obfuscated attacks across multiple languages and character encodings. The proposed framework measures how effectively current LLMs resist manipulation into performing harmful actions. Our findings reveal systematic vulnerabilities across all tested models. Even direct prompt injections frequently induce the generation of phishing content, websites, and malware, while elaborate prompts achieve even higher malicious compliance rates, particularly for phishing. Models such as DeepSeek, Gemini, and Grok show especially high susceptibility under complex instructions. Notably, non-English languages consistently exhibit higher compliance rates than English, exposing significant gaps in multilingual safety alignment. Although simple character encodings reduce malicious outputs, they do not eliminate them. These results highlight persistent challenges in LLM safety and underscore the urgent need for stronger defenses and improved security mechanisms to support the ethical and secure deployment of LLMs in cybersecurity sensitive contexts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文对六种主流大型语言模型（DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini、Grok、Llama 和 Qwen）在多种对抗性提示注入场景下的安全性进行了实证评估。研究背景：随着LLM在关键领域的广泛应用，提示注入漏洞日益突出，攻击者可利用这些漏洞生成钓鱼邮件、恶意网站和恶意软件。核心问题：当前LLM在多语言和混淆攻击下的鲁棒性如何？是否能有效抵抗直接和复杂的注入攻击？方法：作者提出了一个统一的评估框架，涵盖直接提示注入和多阶段混淆攻击，涉及多种语言（如英语、土耳其语、德语等）和字符编码（如Base64、Unicode等）。实验设计：对每个模型进行标准化测试，测量其生成恶意内容（如钓鱼邮件、恶意代码）的合规率。主要发现：（1）所有模型均存在系统性漏洞，即使直接注入也能诱导生成有害内容；（2）复杂指令下的恶意合规率更高，尤其针对钓鱼攻击；（3）非英语语言的合规率普遍高于英语，表明多语言安全对齐存在显著缺口；（4）简单的字符编码（如Base64）虽能降低恶意输出，但无法完全消除。这些结果凸显了LLM安全对齐的持久挑战，并强调需要更强的防御机制。主要贡献：提供了首个跨模型、跨语言、跨混淆方式的系统比较，揭示了安全对齐中的语言缺失问题，为后续研究提供了基准。适合读者：AI安全研究者、LLM部署者、安全工程师。

items.title: SurrogateShield: Beyond Redaction for High-Utility, Privacy-Preserving LLM Interactions
items.summary: LLM-based assistants transmit user queries verbatim to third-party API endpoints that lie outside the user's audit or control. When those queries contain personally identifiable information (PII), the data persists on remote infrastructure subject to breach, subpoena, or policy change. Placeholder redaction (the prevailing mitigation) suppresses PII at the cost of semantic coherence, producing structurally degraded queries and correspondingly degraded responses. We present SurrogateShield, a client-side proxy that substitutes detected PII with locally generated, type-consistent surrogate values prior to transmission and restores originals in the response. No real PII crosses the network boundary. Detection runs through a three-stage cascade (PatternScan, EntityTrace, and ContextGuard) covering 22 PII types and quasi-identifier combinations grounded in Sweeney's k-anonymity framework. Surrogate-to-original mappings are sealed in an AES-256-GCM encrypted per-conversation ShadowMap that never leaves the device. Evaluations on a 1,124-query corpus demonstrate that the cascade reliably detects PII, achieving an overall F1 score of 98.87%. Surrogate substitution substantially outperforms placeholder redaction in semantic utility, yielding a 13.26 pp improvement in BERTScore (roberta-large), from 81.59% to 94.85%. Within this corpus, the local pipeline restricted real PII transmission across all tested query types; in a 100-query adversarial trial, a prompted LLM adversary recovered no original values from surrogate-substituted messages.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 SurrogateShield 的客户端代理机制，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）助手在将用户查询发送至第三方 API 时可能泄露个人身份信息（PII）的问题。现有的占位符红action方法虽然能抑制 PII，但会破坏语义连贯性，导致查询质量下降和回复退化。SurrogateShield 在传输前检测并替换 PII 为本地生成的类型一致的替代值（surrogate values），并在响应时恢复原始值，确保没有任何真实 PII 离开用户设备。检测过程采用三级级联架构：PatternScan（基于正则表达式）、EntityTrace（基于命名实体识别）和 ContextGuard（基于上下文规则），覆盖 22 种 PII 类型及基于 Sweeney 的 k-匿名框架的准标识符组合。替代值与原始值的映射存储在经 AES-256-GCM 加密的每会话 ShadowMap 中，且永不离开设备。在包含 1124 条查询的语料库上进行评估，级联检测的整体 F1 分数达到 98.87%。与占位符红action相比，SurrogateShield 在语义效用上显著提升：在 BERTScore（roberta-large）上从 81.59% 提升至 94.85%，提升了 13.26 个百分点。在 100 条查询的对抗性测试中，提示 LLM 攻击者无法从替代值消息中恢复任何原始值。该研究适用于需要保护用户隐私的 LLM 应用场景，如客服助手、医疗咨询等。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在不破坏语义的前提下有效防止 LLM 交互中的 PII 泄露，为隐私保护与模型效用之间的平衡提供了可行方案，对依赖第三方 LLM API 的企业和个人用户具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Closing the Activation-Cone Blind Spot: Response-Time Probing and Unified Defense
items.summary: Inference-time safety methods for large language models have proliferated, yet no systematic comparison exists. We evaluate five defense paradigms (no defense, static steering, CAST, AlphaSteer, probe-gated) across seven instruction-tuned models (7-31B) and five attack types (GCG, AutoDAN, DeepInception, prefilling, intent laundering). Our central finding: prompt-time activation defenses are structurally blind to prefilling attacks. AlphaSteer achieves 0% attack success on GCG, AutoDAN, and intent laundering but 50% on prefilling. We prove a corollary: any defense that gates intervention on a single layer's activation alignment with a benign reference (cone, subspace, or null-space) is blind to attacks that craft activations to lie inside that reference, whether checked at prompt time or per token. As its constructive contrapositive we introduce response-time probing: a linear probe on the model's hidden state at the first generated tokens, with AUROC 0.97-1.00 across all seven models. Combined with a halt, it cuts prefilling attack success to 0/40 on every model with 0% benign false positives, outperforming Llama Guard 3. Cross-template generalisation depends on probe depth, so we scope the claim to the canonical prefilling-template family. Composing the response-halt with AlphaSteer's null-space steering gives an orthogonal split (the halt catches prefilling, AlphaSteer catches semantic attacks), reaching defense success 0.983 on Mistral and 0.994 on Llama and dominating both components. We further show MMLU fails to capture steering's true utility cost, which appears as behavioral hedging rather than factual loss, and that diverse negative training sets cut probe false positives from 80-100% to near zero. Code, attacks, per-sample results, and the judge prompt are released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统评估了大语言模型推理时安全的五种防御范式（无防御、静态引导、CAST、AlphaSteer、探针门控）在七个指令微调模型（7B-31B）和五种攻击类型（GCG、AutoDAN、DeepInception、预填充攻击、意图洗钱）下的表现。核心发现：基于提示时激活的防御对于预填充攻击存在结构性盲区——只要防御检查的是单层激活与良性参考（锥、子空间或零空间）的对齐，那么攻击者就可以通过精心构造激活使其落在该参考内来绕过，无论检查发生在提示时还是每个token。作为建设性反命题，作者提出响应时探测：在模型生成第一个token的隐藏状态上训练线性探针，在七个模型上AUROC达到0.97-1.00。结合生成中止机制，在每一模型上将预填充攻击成功率降至0/40且良性误报率为0%，优于Llama Guard 3。跨模板泛化能力取决于探针深度，因此作者将结论限定在规范预填充模板族内。将响应中止与AlphaSteer的零空间引导组合可形成正交防御（中止捕获预填充，AlphaSteer捕获语义攻击），在Mistral上防御成功率达0.983，Llama上达0.994，均优于各组件单独效果。此外，MMLU无法体现引导的真实效用代价（实际表现为行为对冲而非事实损失），而多样化的负训练集可将探针误报率从80-100%降至接近零。代码、攻击、单样本结果以及评估提示均已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前主流激活防御对预填充攻击的结构性盲区，并提出高效的响应时探测方案，可直接集成到现有防御管线中，显著提升LLM安全水位。

items.title: Breaking the Rounding Trap: Securing LLMs against Quantization-Conditioned Backdoors
items.summary: Model quantization is a key technique for reducing storage and inference costs when deploying large language models in practice. However, recent studies show that the discretization and rounding errors introduced by quantization can be exploited by adversaries to construct quantization-conditioned backdoor (QCB) attacks. Under such attacks, malicious behaviors remain dormant in the full-precision stage and are activated only after quantized deployment, thereby bypassing conventional security auditing and detection mechanisms. To address this threat, we propose a proactive pre-quantization defense method, QuantGuard. Our method introduces differentiable rounding control variables and combines error-guided rounding reversal constraints, output-distribution consistency, and weight-distance regularization to finely regulate critical rounding behaviors. Crucially, QuantGuard utilizes only a small calibration dataset and does not modify existing quantization algorithms. This design breaks the precise alignment between attacker-crafted weight patterns and quantization boundaries, effectively suppressing the post-quantization backdoor activation pathway while preserving the model's original functionality and performance. We conduct systematic experiments on six mainstream LLMs (including the LLaMA-3 and Qwen2.5-Coder) using three quantization precisions (INT8, FP4, and NF4) across three representative scenarios: vulnerable code generation, content injection, and over-refusal. The results show that QuantGuard consistently mitigates QCB attacks, reducing the attack success rate to a level comparable to the clean model while largely preserving performance on general capability benchmarks. With low computational overhead, our method offers an effective, practical solution for secure quantized LLM deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在量化部署中面临的新型安全威胁——量化条件后门（Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor, QCB）攻击——提出了一种名为QuantGuard的主动防御方法。模型量化通过降低参数精度来减少存储和推理成本，但量化过程中的离散化和舍入误差可能被攻击者利用：在未量化的全精度模型中嵌入后门，该后门仅在模型被量化部署后激活，从而绕过传统的安全审计和检测机制。现有防御手段多集中在后训练或推理阶段，难以应对这种针对量化过程的条件触发特性。QuantGuard的创新在于引入可微分的舍入控制变量，并结合误差引导的舍入反转约束、输出分布一致性和权重距离正则化，精细调控关键权重的舍入行为。该方法仅需少量校准数据，不修改现有量化算法，通过破坏攻击者预设的权重模式与量化边界之间的精确对齐，有效抑制量化后的后门激活路径，同时保持模型原有功能与性能。实验在6个主流LLM（包括LLaMA-3和Qwen2.5-Coder）上，采用INT8、FP4和NF4三种量化精度，覆盖易受攻击代码生成、内容注入和过度拒绝三个典型场景。结果表明，QuantGuard能够持续缓解QCB攻击，将攻击成功率降至与干净模型相当的水平，且在通用能力基准测试上几乎无损。该方法计算开销低，为安全部署量化LLM提供了实用解决方案。

items.title: FlipGuard: Defending Large Language Models Against Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor Attacks
items.summary: Model quantization is essential for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), but introduces a critical vulnerability: Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor (QCB) attacks. In these attacks, malicious behaviors remain dormant in full-precision models and activate only after specific quantization distortions, bypassing standard security audits. To mitigate this, we introduce FlipGuard, a proactive defense framework that selectively perturbs model weights prior to quantization. By breaking the adversary's precise alignment between weight patterns and quantization boundaries, FlipGuard suppresses backdoor activation without requiring access to training data or trigger samples. We further propose the Defense Effectiveness Ratio (DER), a unified metric to jointly evaluate security gains, utility preservation, and computational cost. Extensive experiments across seven LLMs (including StarCoder and LLaMA-family models) and three quantization schemes (INT8, FP4, NF4) demonstrate that FlipGuard effectively neutralizes QCBs across three scenarios, i.e., vulnerable code generation, content injection, and over-refusal, achieving high security with negligible performance degradation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 模型量化是实现大型语言模型（LLM）高效部署的关键技术，但本文揭示了一种新型安全威胁：量化条件后门攻击（QCB）。攻击者通过在预训练或微调阶段植入与特定量化边界精确对齐的恶意权重模式，使得后门在完整精度模型中保持休眠，仅在经过特定量化（如INT8、FP4、NF4）后激活，从而绕过常规安全审计。针对这一漏洞，作者提出了FlipGuard，一种无需训练数据或触发器样本的主动防御框架。FlipGuard的核心思想是在量化前对模型权重进行选择性扰动，破坏攻击者精心设计的权重与量化边界之间的对齐，使后门无法在量化后正确激活。为了评估防御效果，作者提出了防御效果比（Defense Effectiveness Ratio, DER），一个统一指标，综合衡量安全收益、模型效用保留和计算开销。在7个LLM（包括StarCoder和LLaMA系列模型）和3种量化方案上的大量实验表明，FlipGuard能有效中和三种QCB攻击场景：脆弱代码生成、内容注入和过度拒绝，在保持极高安全性的同时，模型性能几乎无损。该研究为量化LLM的安全部署提供了前瞻性解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量化后门攻击是一种新型、隐蔽的供应链威胁，传统安全审计在完整精度模型中无法检测。FlipGuard为防御此类攻击提供了无需数据、低开销的主动方法，对LLM量化部署的安全实践有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用模型量化的LLM部署场景，如边缘设备、移动端推理、云端低精度推理等，防止量化后门导致的恶意代码生成、内容篡改或拒绝服务。

items.title: Cybersecurity is the True Frontier for Generative AI Success or Failure
items.summary: Cybersecurity is a real-life test-bed for many machine learning problems at once, especially when considering modern strides in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate processes as ``agents.'' Cybersecurity workflows require orchestrating hundreds of standard and bespoke tools through various formats. The scale of cybersecurity data is enormous; for example, a single malware sample can be viewed as a sequence of billions of tokens. The cost of labeling any file by experts is enormous and labor-intensive, in part because an adversary (possibly a well-funded nation state actor) is attempting to subvert your detection methods. Even skilled experts may disagree on the correct label, creating ambiguity in what constitutes ground truth. When deployed, models must run quickly on billions of items a day, where low-latency is critical for operational success, in a continuously changing environment. In addition, explainability is not optional: analysts demand clear reasoning for model decisions to cope with the large number of false-positive alerts they face daily, and to quickly develop remediation and understand how something went wrong. In short, the amount of complexity cybersecurity is greater than that of natural language and computer vision, and thus we posit that cybersecurity is the better test-case for general AI progress than other, well-studied fields.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出，网络安全领域是检验生成式AI（特别是基于大语言模型的代理系统）成功与否的真正前沿。作者指出，网络安全工作流需要协调数百种标准及定制工具，处理格式多样的数据，且数据规模巨大（例如单个恶意软件样本可视为数十亿token的序列）。标签成本高昂且劳动密集，因为攻击者（可能包括国家资助的行为体）刻意规避检测方法，即使是专家也可能对正确标签存在分歧。部署时，模型需在持续变化的环境中每天处理数十亿项，且低延迟对运营成功至关重要。此外，可解释性不可或缺：分析师需要清晰的推理来应对日常大量误报，并快速制定修复方案。作者认为，网络安全在复杂性上超越了自然语言处理和计算机视觉，因此是衡量通用AI进展更好的测试案例。本文主要贡献在于论证网络安全对AI系统的独特挑战，并呼吁更多研究关注该领域。适合AI安全研究者、安全运营从业者及大语言模型应用开发者阅读。

items.title: Robust Text Watermarking for Large Language Models via Dual Semantic Embeddings
items.summary: This work presents Dual-Embedding Watermarking (DEW), a semantic watermarking scheme for large language models (LLMs) that leverages contextual and token-level embeddings to enhance robustness against paraphrasing and translation. DEW utilizes a signal-processing methodology, applying algebraic vector-space operations to \mbox{token and context embeddings to derive a watermark signal that degrades gracefully under semantic shifts. The method obfuscates the watermark by projecting embedding vectors through pseudo-random matrices seeded with a secret key. Relevant distributions derived from the underlying algebra are evaluated and employed for statistical testing and benchmarking of DEW. Experimental results across multiple LLMs indicate that DEW improves post-paraphrase detection while maintaining competitive text quality, and remains detectable after translation, even when prior semantic watermarks degrade significantly. These findings position DEW as a practical and robust solution for safeguarding LLM-generated text and addressing critical issues in responsible AI deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为双嵌入水印（DEW）的语义水印方案，用于保护大语言模型（LLM）生成文本的版权和来源。现有语义水印在面对改写（paraphrasing）和翻译攻击时鲁棒性不足，DEW通过利用上下文嵌入（context embeddings）和令牌级嵌入（token-level embeddings）的双重语义信息来增强鲁棒性。具体方法上，DEW采用信号处理技术，对令牌和上下文嵌入向量进行代数向量空间操作，生成一个在语义变化下优雅退化的水印信号。为隐藏水印，该方法通过伪随机矩阵（由秘密密钥种子生成）对嵌入向量进行投影，从而混淆水印。基于底层代数推导出的相关分布被用于统计测试和基准评估。实验在多个LLM上进行，结果表明DEW在改写后依然保持良好的检测性能，同时文本质量相当；在翻译攻击下，即使其他语义水印方法大幅退化，DEW仍可检测。该工作为LLM生成文本的负责任部署提供了实用且鲁棒的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方案解决了LLM文本水印在改写和翻译攻击下易失效的痛点，提升了内容溯源与知识产权保护的可信度，对AI安全部署有直接价值。

items.title: A Lifecycle and Application-Stack Survey of Large Language Model Vulnerabilities: Attacks, Risks, Defenses, and Open Problems
items.summary: Large language models are no longer only text generators. They are increasingly embedded in retrieval pipelines, enterprise assistants, coding environments, robotic systems, security-operation workflows, and autonomous agents that can read private data, call tools, write files, execute code, and act across organizational boundaries. This shift changes the security problem: risks do not arise from the model weights alone, but from the full lifecycle and application stack through which data, prompts, model outputs, tools, memories, and user authority interact. This paper systematizes the literature on vulnerabilities in large language model systems through a lifecycle and application-stack lens. We organize attacks across eight stages: data collection, pretraining, post-training alignment, model packaging and supply chain, retrieval and memory, prompting and inference, tool/agent execution, and deployment/maintenance. For each stage, we analyze attacker capabilities, affected security objectives, representative attacks, practical risks, evaluation practices, and defenses. We further map LLM-specific vulnerabilities to confidentiality, integrity, availability, safety, privacy, fairness, accountability, and agency-control objectives. Unlike taxonomies that list isolated attack names, the proposed systematization emphasizes where trust boundaries fail, how untrusted data becomes executable instruction, how delegated authority amplifies model errors, and why point defenses rarely compose. We close with a research agenda for secure LLM systems, including compositional security, provenance-aware retrieval, tool-call containment, long-horizon agent evaluation, privacy-preserving adaptation, realistic red teaming, and deployment-grade incident response.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文是一篇系统化的综述，从生命周期和应用栈的视角梳理了大语言模型（LLM）系统中的漏洞。作者指出，LLM已不再是单纯的文本生成器，而是深度嵌入检索管道、企业助手、编程环境、机器人系统、安全运营工作流以及自主智能体，这些智能体能够读取私有数据、调用工具、写入文件、执行代码并在组织边界内行动。这种转变改变了安全问题的本质：风险不仅来自模型权重本身，更来自数据、提示、模型输出、工具、记忆和用户权限相互作用的完整生命周期和应用栈。论文将攻击组织为八个阶段：数据收集、预训练、后训练对齐、模型打包与供应链、检索与记忆、提示与推理、工具/智能体执行、部署与维护。针对每个阶段，分析了攻击者能力、受影响的安全目标、代表性攻击、实际风险、评估实践和防御措施。进一步将LLM特定漏洞映射到保密性、完整性、可用性、安全性、隐私、公平性、问责制和代理控制等安全目标。与仅列出孤立攻击名称的分类法不同，该综述强调了信任边界何时失效、不可信数据如何变成可执行指令、委托授权如何放大模型错误，以及为什么点防御难以组合。最后提出了安全LLM系统的研究议程，包括组合安全、可溯源检索、工具调用约束、长期智能体评估、隐私保护适配、现实红队测试以及部署级应急响应。本文适合安全研究人员、LLM开发者、AI安全工程师阅读，以系统理解LLM攻击面并指导防御设计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对LLM安全从业者而言，本文提供了首个覆盖全生命周期和应用栈的漏洞系统化梳理，帮助识别信任边界失效点并理解点防御的局限性，是构建安全LLM系统的重要参考。

items.title: Fission: MessageQueueTrigger scaler manager materializes Secret values into Deployment envvars and accepts arbitrary user PodSpec
items.summary:
### Summary

The Fission MessageQueueTrigger (MQT) scaler controller exposed two privilege-escalation primitives to any subject able to create MQTs in a namespace.

### Details

**1. Secret materialization.** `getEnvVarlist` in `pkg/mqtrigger/scalermanager.go` read the Secret named in `Spec.Secret` using the controller's cluster-wide `secrets/get` RBAC and emitted each key as a literal `EnvVar.Value`, copying
the plaintext secret content into the connector Deployment's pod template. A subject holding `messagequeuetriggers/create` but **not** `secrets/get` could exfiltrate any Secret in the namespace by pointing an MQT at it.

**2. PodSpec injection.** `Spec.PodSpec` was merged into the controller-built connector PodSpec via `util.MergePodSpec` with no allowlist on which fields could come from the user. An MQT could substitute `Containers[].Image` (run any
image), override `Command`/`Args`, inject `Env`, add `VolumeMounts` + `Volumes`, override `ServiceAccountName`, and set `HostNetwork`/`HostPID`/`HostIPC` — turning `messagequeuetriggers/create` into effective `deployments/create` with an
 arbitrary image and service account.

### Impact

A tenant with only `messagequeuetriggers.fission.io/create` in a namespace could read any Secret in that namespace and run an arbitrary container image under an arbitrary service account, escalating well beyond their intended RBAC.

### Fix

Fixed in [#3367](https://github.com/fission/fission/pull/3367) and released in [v1.24.0](https://github.com/fission/fission/releases/tag/v1.24.0).

- `getEnvVarlist` now emits `EnvVar.ValueFrom.SecretKeyRef` so the connector pod resolves values at start time under its own service account. The secret values are never written into the Deployment object and never logged.
- A new allowlist, `MergeAllowedPodSpecFields` (`pkg/executor/util/merge_allowlist.go`), accepts only `NodeSelector`, `Tolerations`, `Affinity`, `RuntimeClassName`, and per-container `Resources`. All other user-supplied fields are
dropped at the controller layer, and the validating webhook rejects every populated non-allowlisted field with a clear error. The webhook and the merge helper share a single canonical `DisallowedPodSpecFields` enumeration so they cannot
drift.

### Behavioural change

MQT authors that previously overrode the connector image, command, args, env, volumes, service account, or host namespaces via `Spec.PodSpec` will see those fields rejected at admission (or silently dropped if the webhook is disabled).
Allowlisted fields flow through unchanged.

items.title: The Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score (CDTS): Competence-Coupled Trust Degradation Across Deepfake Detectors
items.summary: Modern deepfake detectors are rarely consumed as bare classifiers. In moderation, provenance, and verification pipelines their output probability is read as a degree of trust, so its calibration matters as much as raw accuracy. We reframe deepfake detection as a calibrated, self-auditing trust instrument, the Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score (CDTS), and identify what governs its trustworthiness. Our central finding is a competence-calibration coupling: the calibration of the trust score degrades as the detector's discriminative competence falls. We establish it across 32 configurations (pooled Pearson r = -0.81), demonstrate it within a single dataset, reinforce it by inducing low competence directly, and replicate it on a fourth held-out dataset the detectors never trained on. It holds across three architecturally distinct detectors, two convolutional networks and a CLIP vision transformer (r = -0.88, -0.83, -0.86). The result is also deployable: a single calibrator frozen on in-domain data fails on exactly the low-competence generators the coupling flags (its error tracks competence at r = -0.98), and competence is estimable without labels, so a label-free monitor flags calibration risk on unseen generators and routing source-batches on a reference-free competence estimate lowers overall AURC and improves the low-to-mid coverage operating region relative to confidence-based routing. The same competence factor also drives calibration inequity across demographic subgroups (distinct from accuracy inequity) and explanation faithfulness. We therefore argue that detector trustworthiness is organized by competence as a shared driver, that competence is the right quantity to estimate and condition on, and that trust scoring must be competence-aware. We offer the CDTS wrapper as the mechanism, and report openly where the unification is tight and where it is architecture-specific.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出校准深度伪造信任分数（CDTS），将深度伪造检测重新定义为一种经过校准的、自我审计的信任工具。核心发现是检测器的信任分数校准会随其判别能力下降而退化，即能力-校准耦合。作者在32个配置上验证了这一现象（合并Pearson r = -0.81），并在单个数据集内、通过直接诱导低能力、以及在第四个未见数据集上复现了该结果。该现象适用于三种架构不同的检测器（两个卷积网络和一个CLIP视觉变换器，r分别为-0.88、-0.83、-0.86）。进一步实验表明，在域内数据上冻结的单一校准器会在低能力生成器上失败（其错误与能力的相关性r = -0.98），而无标签的能力估计可标记未见生成器上的校准风险；基于无参考能力估计的路由可降低整体AURC并改善低中覆盖率区域的性能。此外，能力因素还驱动了跨人口亚组的校准不平等（不同于准确率不平等）和解释忠实度。因此，作者认为检测器的可信度由能力作为共同驱动因素组织，信任评分必须考虑能力因素，并提供CDTS封装作为机制。

items.title: Automated High-Precision Extraction and Forensic Verification of Data-Bearing Vector Figures
items.summary: The quantitative record of science and engineering is increasingly carried by figures rather than text or tables, and a reader who needs the underlying numbers must usually re-digitize them by hand: slowly, imprecisely, and with no way to prove the result is faithful. Yet when a figure is stored as vector graphics, its data are not approximated by the picture but encoded in it: the renderer writes each marker and vertex at a printed precision that, for the dominant scientific toolchain, exceeds the data's own. We turn this into three contributions, one per shortcoming of hand digitization. First, a precision theory bounding how accurately data can be recovered for a given renderer and export format: bit-exact float32 for matplotlib markers, and a calibration-limited three to four significant figures end to end. Second, an automatic extractor that decodes a figure in one pass with no human in the loop, in place of the slow point-by-point tracing a digitizer demands. Third, a verification theory: recovery is injective except on a characterized, vanishingly small interval near zero; accidental agreement between unrelated data is astronomically unlikely; and a re-rendering certificate binds the recovered values to the markers, lines, and ticks the figure draws, not its text, making a result non-repudiable. With no ground truth used during recovery, decoded figures match external archives (Planck 2018 to 10^-9; the Keeling CO2 record to 5*10^-4, and one decoded figure independently reproduces a correction to the Chinchilla scaling-law confidence interval. We map the achievable precision across common renderers and their PDF, SVG, and EPS formats. What we deliver is certified data; the scientific significance of any particular dataset lies outside this paper's scope, and recovered values are candidates for human review, never accusations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种从矢量图形中自动高精度提取数据并进行取证验证的方法。研究背景：科学和工程领域的定量记录越来越多地以图形而非文本或表格形式呈现，读者需要获取底层数据时通常需要手动重新数字化，过程缓慢、不精确且无法证明结果的真实性。核心问题：如何自动、精确地从矢量图中提取数据，并提供可信的验证机制。论文的三个主要贡献：1）精度理论：针对给定的渲染器和导出格式（如matplotlib标记和PDF/SVG/EPS），界定了数据恢复的理论精度，对matplotlib标记可达位精确的float32，端到端校准后可达三到四位有效数字。2）自动提取器：一种无需人工干预的单次解码算法，替代手动逐点追踪，实现高效自动化。3）验证理论：恢复过程除原点附近极小区间外是单射的，不同数据集偶然一致的可能性极低；通过重新渲染证书将恢复值与图形中的标记、线条和刻度绑定（而非文本），实现不可否认性。实验证明：在没有使用真实数据的情况下，解码图形与外部档案高度吻合（Planck 2018精度达10^-9；Keeling CO2记录达5×10^-4），并独立复现了Chinchilla缩放定律置信区间的修正。论文还映射了常见渲染器和矢量格式下的可达精度。该研究为数据提取提供了可认证的可靠结果，但任何特定数据集的重要性不在论文范围内，恢复值仅供人工审核参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文为从科学图表中自动、可信地提取数据提供了理论基础和实用工具，解决了手动数字化不精确、费时且无法验证的问题，对需要复用公开图表数据的科研人员和取证分析师具有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响科研数据复用、科学文献元分析、学术不端检测等领域；其验证理论可推广至任何基于矢量图形的数字取证场景。

items.title: Your Space is My Zone: Demystifying the Security Risks of AI-Powered Applications on Pre-Trained Model Hubs
items.summary: AI-powered Applications (AI-Apps), hosted on platforms such as Hugging Face, are democratizing access to pre-trained models through online inference and fine-tuning services. While lowering AI adoption barriers, these platforms introduce an unexplored attack surface, as AI-Apps are often developed by untrusted parties with weak isolation and misconfigured security settings. In this paper, we present the first systematic security analysis of AI-Apps across three leading platforms. To structure our investigation, we map the AI-App lifecycle to established risk taxonomies (e.g., OWASP), identifying five threat categories and ten attack vectors ranging from generic web flaws to high-impact architectural issues. Our analysis reveals critical failures including broken access control, insecure resource reuse, insufficient input validation, and sensitive data exposure. Notably, we uncover three novel architectural vulnerabilities inherent to platform design and demonstrate how traditional issues (e.g., world-readable logs) are uniquely amplified in this ecosystem. To assess real-world impact, we develop an analysis framework Insightor and apply it to over 970,000 public AI-Apps. Alarmingly, we find thousands of apps leaking credentials, hundreds containing input injection vulnerabilities that allow arbitrary code execution, and tens harboring embedded backdoors -- indicating active exploitation. We have responsibly disclosed all findings to the affected platforms and developers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次系统性地分析了托管在如Hugging Face等平台上的AI应用（AI-Apps）的安全风险。这些平台通过提供在线推理和微调服务，降低了AI模型的使用门槛，但同时也引入了新的攻击面，因为AI应用通常由不可信方开发，且存在隔离薄弱、安全配置错误等问题。研究团队映射了AI应用的生命周期与OWASP等风险分类法，识别出五个威胁类别和十个攻击向量，涵盖从通用Web漏洞到高影响力的架构问题。分析揭示了关键缺陷，包括访问控制失效、资源重用不安全、输入验证不足和敏感数据泄露。特别地，他们发现了三种平台设计固有的新型架构漏洞，并展示了传统问题（如全局可读日志）如何在此生态系统中被放大。为了评估实际影响，他们开发了分析框架Insightor，并应用于超过97万个公开AI应用。结果令人震惊：数千个应用泄露凭据，数百个存在可导致任意代码执行的输入注入漏洞，数十个嵌入了后门——表明正在被积极利用。研究人员已向受影响平台和开发者负责地披露了所有发现。该工作为AI应用生态的安全评估提供了重要参考，适合安全研究人员、平台开发者和AI应用开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着AI应用在预训练模型平台上的普及，其安全风险日益突出。本文首次系统性揭示了该生态中广泛存在的漏洞和攻击向量，包括架构性缺陷和活跃利用案例，为平台安全设计和应用开发提供了关键警示。

items.title: A Lightweight Post-Quantum Authentication Framework for 5G Base Station Bootstrapping
items.summary: The absence of authenticated bootstrapping between User Equipments (UEs) and Base Stations (BSs) in 5G leaves System Information Block (SIB) broadcasts unprotected, enabling fake BS attacks, man-in-the-middle interception, and spoofed emergency alerts. Prior efforts such as Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)-based certificate chains, token-based schemes, and identity-based signatures either impose overhead exceeding 5G's strict packet-size constraints or lack post-quantum (PQ) security. Direct NIST-PQC integration is infeasible: ML-DSA requires 34 fragmented SIB1 packets and up to 5,282,ms end-to-end delay, and FN-DSA still requires 13 fragments and up to 1,920,ms. We propose $\emulsion$, a symmetric chained publicly verifiable authentication framework for 5G/6G BS broadcast authentication. EMULSION is the first framework to exploit native 5G architectural features: fixed SIB transmission windows, millisecond-level time synchronization, and eSIM/USIM credential management to achieve genuine PQ security at symmetric-key efficiency. It uses a TESLA-style HMAC chain anchored by a compact PQ signature (MAYO) applied once per epoch, fitting authentication within a single packet with no fragmentation and eliminating certificate transmission entirely. Unlike all prior schemes, EMULSION protects the full SIB family (SIB1-SIB21). Evaluated on a real over-the-air 5G testbed, EMULSION achieves 33x lower end-to-end delay and 31x less communication overhead than ML-DSA, and 12x lower delay and 5.4x less overhead than FN-DSA. We formally prove the security of EMULSION and open-source its implementation for public testing and adaptation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对5G网络中用户设备（UE）与基站（BS）之间缺乏认证启动机制的问题展开研究。当前5G系统信息块（SIB）广播处于无保护状态，容易遭受伪基站攻击、中间人拦截以及虚假紧急警报等威胁。现有的解决方案如基于公钥基础设施（PKI）的证书链、令牌方案和基于身份的签名，要么因开销过大而超出5G严格的报文大小限制，要么缺乏后量子（PQ）安全性。直接集成NIST后量子密码算法亦不可行：ML-DSA需要分割成34个SIB1报文，端到端延迟高达5282毫秒；FN-DSA仍需要13个片段和1920毫秒延迟。为此，论文提出了EMULSION——一种用于5G/6G基站广播认证的对称链式公开可验证认证框架。EMULSION首次利用5G架构的原生特性：固定的SIB传输窗口、毫秒级时间同步以及eSIM/USIM凭据管理，在对称密钥效率下实现真正的后量子安全性。它采用TESLA风格的HMAC链，每个时段用一个紧凑的后量子签名（MAYO）锚定，整个认证过程可放入单个报文，无需分片，完全省去证书传输。与所有先前方案不同，EMULSION保护完整的SIB家族（SIB1到SIB21）。在真实的5G空中测试平台上评估，EMULSION实现比ML-DSA低33倍的端到端延迟和31倍的通信开销，比FN-DSA低12倍延迟和5.4倍开销。论文还正式证明了EMULSION的安全性，并开源了实现供公众测试和适配。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为5G/6G网络提供首个兼具后量子安全与对称密钥效率的广播认证方案，有望从根本上解决伪基站等重大安全威胁，对移动通信安全演进具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响5G/6G基站广播认证安全，可推广至其他需要低延迟、小报文的后量子认证场景，如物联网、卫星通信等。

items.title: Semantic Leakage and Privacy Preservation in Relay-Assisted Semantic Communications
items.summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm in which the transmission of task-relevant information is prioritized over raw data, enabling efficient and robust communication under resource and channel constraints. In this paper, the privacy implications of relay-assisted SemCom systems are studied, where the intermediate relay node operates directly on learned latent representations. It is shown that the relay, even without access to source data, can reliably infer semantic meaning and reconstruct signals with performance comparable to that of the legitimate receiver, revealing a fundamental privacy vulnerability of semantic representations. To address this issue, an iterative adversarial training framework is proposed in which a strong, adaptively trained eavesdropper at the relay is explicitly accounted for. The proposed approach alternates between optimizing the relay's eavesdropping function and the legitimate system, resulting in representations that preserve semantic decoding performance at the intended receiver while degrading semantic inference at the relay. The semantic accuracy gap between the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper is significantly enlarged across channel conditions. Importantly, this protection is achieved in a stealthy manner, with high reconstruction fidelity maintained while semantic leakage is selectively suppressed.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了中继辅助语义通信系统中的隐私泄露问题。语义通信（SemCom）通过仅传输任务相关的高层语义特征来提升通信效率，但本文发现中继节点即使无法访问原始数据，也能从学习到的潜在表示中可靠推断语义含义并重构信号，其性能接近合法接收者，揭示了语义表示的固有隐私漏洞。为应对这一威胁，作者提出了一种迭代对抗训练框架：在训练过程中显式考虑一个自适应强窃听者（位于中继处），通过交替优化窃听者功能和合法系统，使得生成的表示在合法接收者处保持语义解码性能，同时抑制中继处的语义推理。实验表明，该方法在不同信道条件下显著扩大了合法接收者与窃听者之间的语义准确率差距，且能在保持高重构保真度的同时选择性抑制语义泄露，实现了隐蔽的隐私保护。该研究适用于无线通信安全、隐私保护机器学习、语义通信系统设计等领域的从业者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统揭示中继辅助语义通信中潜在表示的隐私泄露风险，并提出可扩展的对抗防御框架，对设计隐私感知的下一代语义通信系统具有重要指导意义。

items.title: Robocalls: A Worldwide or US-only Problem? Analyzing Spam and Fraud in International Phone Calls
items.summary: Unsolicited automated phone calls (robocalls) are a serious threat: in the US alone, these calls resulted in reported losses of 1.1$ billion during 2025. Phishing and spoofing consistently rank among the most reported crimes within the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center, with phone call scams having the highest reported median loss. Combating robocalls is difficult due to many legal and practical constraints: robocalls often encompass multiple legal jurisdictions of different countries/states, the large volume of robocalls, their multilingual nature, the lack of publicly available data, privacy concerns with obtaining data, etc. We present a study of international robocalls, aggregating robocall reports from countries across all inhabited continents and contribute by providing new findings on international robocalls from 65 different countries. We also present the first publicly available multimodal and international robocall dataset: 8.7 million call detail records, 839 robocall transcripts from 28 identified robocall campaign clusters, and 677 robocall recordings. We describe our methodology for collecting robocall data over a 9-month period and provide a detailed analysis comparing robocalls in the US with those in other countries. Our analysis covers several aspects, including uncovering calling patterns, identifying co-targeting attacks, discovering common robocall campaigns, extracting callback numbers, analyzing linguistic differences among robocalls in the same language but different regions, and other insights. Our results indicate that although robocalls are an international problem, the severity of the threat is significantly higher in the US than in other countries. We provide steps for future research and suggest remedies to reduce the effectiveness of robocalls based on our analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对全球范围内（尤其是跨国）的骚扰电话（robocalls）问题进行了系统性研究。背景方面，骚扰电话在美国造成了严重的经济损失（2025年报告损失11亿美元），且与网络钓鱼和冒充诈骗并列FBI互联网犯罪投诉中心最常见的犯罪类型。由于涉及多国司法管辖、语言多样性、数据难以获取等法律与实操限制，国际骚扰电话的治理极为困难。本文基于65个国家的骚扰电话报告，构建了首个公开可用的多模态国际骚扰电话数据集，包含870万条通话详细记录、839份来自28个识别出的诈骗活动集群的呼叫脚本，以及677段呼叫录音。作者在9个月时间内收集数据，详细描述了方法论，并对美国与其他国家的骚扰电话进行了对比分析。分析涵盖呼叫模式、协同目标攻击、常见诈骗活动、回拨号码提取、同语言不同地区的语言差异等多个维度。结果表明，骚扰电话虽为国际性问题，但美国所面临的威胁严重程度显著高于其他国家。最后，论文提出了未来研究方向以及基于分析结果的减轻骚扰电话效果的建议。该研究适合安全研究人员、电信运营商、反欺诈从业者以及政策制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 骚扰电话是跨国电信诈骗的核心载体，但此前缺乏公开的国际数据集与跨地区对比分析。本文填补了这一空白，为全球协同防御和区域差异化策略提供了实证基础。

items.title: Exploring Side-Channel Protections in Hardware Implementations of PQC ML-KEM Verification
items.summary: As ML-KEM is adopted as a post-quantum cryptographic standard, resilience against physical side-channel attacks has become essential. Among the constituent steps, the decapsulation Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO) verification is particularly vulnerable to side-channel power and electromagnetic (EM) analysis. In this work, we focus on common FPGA-based implementations and examine their side-channel vulnerabilities, and compare them with those of microcontroller implementations. Three verification implementations, unprotected, hash-based (first-order), and higher-order masked, are evaluated for side-channel security on both a microcontroller and an FPGA. While FPGAs offer higher speed and parallelism, they often exhibit stronger side-channel leakage, especially in high bandwidth configurations. The higher-order masked designs still leak information about the underlying data due to hardware-level effects and data-dependent processing. Our experiments show that their parallelized processing on FPGAs introduces sufficient first-order leakage for full secret-key recovery. These results underscore the persistent challenge of securing PQC algorithms in performance-constrained and parallelized hardware environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文探讨了后量子密码标准 ML-KEM 中 Fujisaki-Okamoto 验证步骤的硬件实现侧信道防护问题。ML-KEM 的封装验证对侧信道功耗和电磁分析特别敏感。作者聚焦于常见 FPGA 实现，并与微控制器实现进行对比，评估了三种验证实现：未保护、哈希基（一阶）和高阶掩码。实验表明，尽管 FPGA 提供更高速度和并行性，但其在高带宽配置下表现出更强的侧信道泄漏。高阶掩码设计因硬件级效应和数据相关处理仍会泄漏底层数据信息。在 FPGA 上，并行处理引入足以恢复完整私钥的一阶泄漏。这些结果强调了在性能受限和并行化硬件环境中确保 PQC 算法安全性的持续挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ML-KEM 是即将广泛部署的后量子加密标准，其硬件实现若存在侧信道漏洞，将直接威胁密钥安全。该研究揭示了 FPGA 实现中高阶掩码的局限性，对安全硬件设计有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用 ML-KEM 的硬件安全模块、HSM、安全芯片等；可迁移至其他后量子密码算法的硬件实现评估。

items.title: Hybrid Topological Data Analysis and LSTM Networks for Enhanced Network Intrusion Detection Using CIC-IDS2017 Dataset
items.summary: Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) are crucial in cybersecurity infrastructure, needing advanced techniques to detect hostile activity in network traffic. This research introduces a hybrid approach that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to improve anomaly detection in network security. Our multi-layered design combines TDA's persistent homology with LSTM networks to capture topological characteristics of network traffic patterns and simulate temporal sequences. We assessed our methodology using the CIC-IDS2017 dataset, which includes over 2.8 million labelled flows, 77 network variables, and 14 attack categories that reflect modern threat landscapes such as DDoS, brute force, web attacks, penetration, and botnet activities. Integrating Betti curves and persistence diagrams with deep learning architectures enhances feature extraction performance. Our hybrid TDA+LSTM model has an AUC of 1.000 and F1-score of 1.000, with 5-fold cross-validation producing a mean AUC of 1.000 $\pm$ 0.000 and mean F1 of 0.999 $\pm$ 0.001. An ablation research demonstrates the complimentary contributions of topological (F1=0.990) and temporal characteristics (F1=1.000). Comparative research shows that the suggested strategy beats TDA+Random Forest (F1=0.994) and Isolation Forest (F1=0.835) baselines in several attack categories.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对网络安全中的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）性能提升问题，提出了一种结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）与长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的混合方法。研究背景指出传统NIDS在处理复杂、动态的网络流量时存在局限性，而TDA能够从高维数据中提取拓扑特征（如Betti曲线、持久性图），LSTM则擅长建模时间序列依赖。作者设计了多层架构：首先使用TDA对网络流量进行特征提取，捕获流量的拓扑结构；然后将拓扑特征输入LSTM网络，学习时序模式。实验采用CIC-IDS2017数据集，包含超过280万个标记流、77个网络变量和14种攻击类别（如DDoS、暴力破解、Web攻击、渗透、僵尸网络）。结果表明，混合TDA+LSTM模型在二分类异常检测中取得了AUC=1.000、F1=1.000的指标，5折交叉验证平均AUC=1.000±0.000、平均F1=0.999±0.001。消融实验证实拓扑特征（F1=0.990）与时序特征（F1=1.000）具有互补性；对比研究显示，该方法优于TDA+随机森林（F1=0.994）和孤立森林（F1=0.835）基线。尽管指标过于完美可能暗示过拟合或数据泄露风险，但文章展示了TDA与深度学习结合在NIDS领域的潜力。主要贡献在于：1) 提出TDA+LSTM混合框架；2) 在标准数据集上验证了有效性；3) 提供了特征互补性分析。适合对NIDS、拓扑数据分析、深度学习应用感兴趣的安全研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 将拓扑数据分析引入NIDS是较新的尝试，可能提升对复杂攻击模式的检测能力；但AUC=1.000的指标需谨慎看待，需独立复现验证。

items.title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning based Intrusion Detection in Realistic IoT Networks
items.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is rapidly growing and expanding into various sectors, such as healthcare, transportation, smart homes, and more. Despite the benefits of using IoT devices, they present several challenges. Given the significant role these devices play in our lives, it is crucial to address issues related to their security and privacy. These devices are limited in resources, which complicates their security and the protection of the data that they manage. The paper aims to examine intrusion detection systems using the Gotham2025 dataset, generated through the Gotham testbed, which consists of 78 emulated IoT devices utilising various protocols, including MQTT, CoAP, and RTSP, to assist in safeguarding IoT networks from attacks. We conduct a comparative analysis between five machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Deep Neural Network. We demonstrate that the Random Forest Classifier was the top-performing model, achieving an F1-score of 0.99 in classifying attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对物联网（IoT）网络安全中的入侵检测问题展开研究，重点探讨了在资源受限的IoT设备环境下如何有效检测攻击。作者利用Gotham2025数据集进行评估，该数据集通过Gotham测试平台生成，模拟了78个采用MQTT、CoAP和RTSP等多种协议的IoT设备。论文对五种机器学习算法进行了对比分析：随机森林（Random Forest）、XGBoost、逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、朴素贝叶斯（Naive Bayes）和深度神经网络（Deep Neural Network）。实验结果表明，随机森林分类器表现最优，在攻击分类任务上达到了0.99的F1分数。研究背景指出，IoT设备在医疗、交通、智能家居等领域广泛应用，但其资源受限特性导致安全与隐私保护面临挑战。论文的核心贡献在于验证了基于机器学习的入侵检测在真实IoT网络中的有效性，并为实际部署提供了算法选择依据。该研究适合对IoT安全、入侵检测系统及机器学习应用感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。

items.title: No Prompt, No Leaks: A Robust Generative Steganography Framework via Prompt-Free Diffusion
items.summary: Generative image steganography synthesizes stego images directly from secret information to achieve inherent security advantages. Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have recently emerged as a fundamental image steganography framework that modulates secret latent representations with text prompts. Limited by the inflexibility of text prompts, these methods still struggle to generate high-quality stego images and accurately recover secret images. In this work, we propose a prompt-free diffusion image steganography framework that integrates style semantic priors to control more robust and reliable stego image generation. Specifically, a Cascaded Affine Coupling Module (CACM) establishes a bijective, deterministic mapping between a secret image and its latent representation. Then, style semantics are integrated into the diffusion process to control latent representation and ensure visual imperceptibility in the generated stego images. To mitigate trajectory deviations stemming from the unconditioned reverse process, a predictor-corrector mechanism is introduced to iteratively refine the generation trajectory via feedback from the current and predicted next states. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods in terms of security, secret image reconstruction accuracy and controllability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种无提示的扩散图像隐写框架，以解决现有基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的隐写方法因依赖文本提示而导致生成图像质量低、秘密图像恢复不准确的问题。核心创新包括：1）级联仿射耦合模块（CACM），在秘密图像与其潜在表示之间建立双射确定性映射；2）将风格语义先验集成到扩散过程中，控制潜在表示并确保生成隐写图像的视觉不可察觉性；3）引入预测-校正机制，通过当前状态和预测下一状态的反馈迭代修正无条件反向过程中的轨迹偏差。实验表明，该方法在安全性、秘密图像重建精度和可控性方面优于现有技术。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种无需文本提示的稳健隐写框架，提升了隐蔽通信的安全性和图像质量，对信息安全领域的隐写术发展具有参考价值。

items.title: The Decomposition Is the Fingerprint: Per-Component Identity for Agent Skills
items.summary: AI agents increasingly acquire and execute skills at runtime: bundles of prompt instructions, executable code, and tool declarations fetched from marketplaces and other agents. Governing them needs a stable notion of skill identity, yet cryptographic hashing is engineered to destroy the very similarity we need, as a one-character edit scrambles the digest. We present a compact, locality-sensitive fingerprint that embeds each component of a skill and projects it to bits with a multi-bank SimHash, giving a fixed 120-byte signature compared in constant time by Hamming distance. Our central claim is that keeping the fingerprint as a per-component triple (prompt, code, tools), rather than a single score, is what makes it useful: the triple recovers skill-family identity through paraphrase, renaming, refactoring, and controlled code translation when another component remains shared, while independent multilingual reimplementation is not recovered; it also localizes which component carries the reuse. We claim lineage, not behavioral equivalence: identity supplies the structural axis of a registry and leaves safety to behavioral verification. The fingerprint reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.974 (95% CI [0.956, 0.994]) over 4,950 pairwise comparisons while using 77x fewer bits than the embedding it approximates, with ranking preserved in expectation and finite-bit concentration; the per-component split turns one number into relationship classification, families, novelty, and a portable "SkillBOM" for a skill registry. On a 906-skill injection benchmark the fingerprint recognizes injected skills as tampered copies of a known base and localizes the change, but recognition is not trust: it remains, by design, an identity signal complementary to behavioral verification rather than a safety verdict.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对AI agent在运行时动态获取技能（prompt指令、可执行代码、工具声明等组合）的身份识别问题展开研究。由于技能可能来自市场或其他agent，需要一种稳定的身份标识来管理技能来源和变更追踪。传统的加密哈希对微小改动敏感（如单字符编辑会完全改变摘要），无法满足相似性需求。为此，作者提出了一种紧凑的、局部敏感的数字指纹方法：首先将技能分解为prompt、code、tools三个独立组件，分别通过多bank SimHash投影到比特位，生成固定120字节的签名，并通过汉明距离进行常数时间比较。核心创新在于保持每个组件的独立指纹（而非合并为一个分数），使得指纹能够通过组件的共同部分恢复技能家族身份（如经过释义、重命名、重构、受控代码翻译等操作后，只要某个组件共享即可识别），同时独立的多语言重写不会被识别。该方法可用于技能注册表中的谱系追踪，而非行为等价性判定。实验在4,950个成对比较上达到AUC 0.974（95% CI [0.956, 0.994]），且使用的比特数比其近似的嵌入向量少77倍，排序期望保持且有限比特集中。在906个技能注入基准测试中，指纹能识别出注入技能是已知基础的篡改副本并定位变化，但作者强调该指纹仅作为行为验证的补充身份信号，而非安全判决。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着AI agent市场兴起，技能安全和溯源成为关键。该指纹提供了轻量级的技能身份和谱系识别方法，有助于检测技能篡改、克隆和供应链风险，是Agent安全治理的基础工具。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于Agent技能市场/仓库的注册表管理、技能来源验证、完整性检查；可迁移至任何模块化AI组件的相似度与谱系分析场景。

items.title: Probe Choice Changes Canary-Memorization Verdicts: Three Post-Hoc Disagreement Case Studies in a Text-Dominant LoRA-Tuned Autoregressive Testbed
items.summary: We audit a fixed prefix-window mean-NLL memorization probe (K=20) on a Qwen2.5-VL-7B canary testbed and report three post-hoc cases where it disagrees with full-span secret NLL or greedy exact-recall. C3 (false negative, window truncation): damage lands on hex tokens outside K=20; the probe stays flat while hit@1 drops. C4 (false positive, non-secret drift): the probe moves, but approximately 99% sits on non-secret preamble; the secret span and hit@1 are unchanged. C5 (ambiguous in-window drop): the probe falls on an undertrained baseline while full-span hex is positive and hit@1=0. Recommendation: report (i) full-span secret NLL, (ii) a span-localised decomposition, (iii) behavioural exact-recall at k>=4, and (iv) decoy probes before asserting secret-specificity. Evidence is on controlled canaries in one backbone; magnitudes are testbed-specific.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文以Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型为骨干，通过LoRA微调构建了一个以文本为主的canary测试平台，审计了一种固定前缀窗口（K=20）的平均负对数似然（mean-NLL）记忆探测器的可靠性。研究发现了三种后验不一致案例：C3假阴性案例中，由于窗口截断，对关键十六进制token的损害落在K=20之外，导致探测器平坦不变而精确召回率（hit@1）下降；C4假阳性案例中，探测器数值移动，但约99%的贡献来自非秘文的序言部分，秘文区间及hit@1保持不变；C5模糊案例中，探测器在欠训练的基线上下降，而全跨度十六进制NLL为正且hit@1为0。作者指出，单一前缀窗口探测器可能误导对模型记忆程度的判断，并建议同时报告（i）全跨度秘文NLL、（ii）跨度局部化分解、（iii）至少k>=4的行为精确召回率，以及（iv）在断言秘文特异性之前使用诱饵探测器。该研究强调了探测选择对LLM隐私审计结论的关键影响。

items.title: Secure-CHG: A Comprehensive Framework for Robust and Fair Federated Learning via Hybrid Defense and Contribution-Aware Trust
items.summary: Federated Learning (FL) is highly susceptible to stealthy backdoor attacks, which aim to force a model into predicting an attacker-chosen target class for inputs containing a specific trigger. However, existing statistical defenses primarily focus on the early stages of model convergence. In this paper, we identify a fundamental vulnerability termed ``Late-stage Failure.'' We demonstrate that as the global model converges, decaying gradient norms render malicious and benign updates morphologically indistinguishable. This vanishing statistical variance effectively blinds traditional defenses, enabling adaptive adversaries to remain dormant and subsequently hijack the training process. To overcome these constraints, we propose Secure-CHG, a hybrid framework that pivots the defense paradigm from superficial morphological detection toward intrinsic semantic contribution verification. Secure-CHG employs an adaptive defense pipeline: a cascaded statistical filter stabilizes optimization during the early oscillatory phase, while a novel CHG-Shapley mechanism takes over during late-stage convergence. By leveraging sample hardness (i.e., local training loss) to project updates into a composite Hardness-Gradient space, it effectively amplifies adversarial semantic traces, enabling the isolation of stealthy attackers even as gradient norms vanish. Furthermore, we derive a closed-form solution for CHG-Shapley, facilitating low-complexity, retraining-free node valuation and trust-modulated aggregation. Extensive evaluations on CIFAR-10, MedMNIST, and NEU-SDDB demonstrate that Secure-CHG effectively mitigates Late-stage Failure. Specifically, it significantly suppresses advanced backdoor attacks, reducing their attack success rate by 2.3$\times$ and 2.0$\times$ relative to the mainstream Krum and Trimmed Mean baselines, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于联邦学习中的后门攻击防御问题。作者首先发现现有统计防御方法存在一个根本性漏洞——“晚期失败”（Late-stage Failure）：随着全局模型收敛，梯度范数逐渐减小，导致恶意更新与良性更新在形态上难以区分，传统基于统计特征的防御方法失效。为克服这一局限，论文提出Secure-CHG混合防御框架，将防御范式从表面的形态检测转向内在的语义贡献验证。框架包含自适应防御流水线：在早期振荡阶段，级联统计滤波器稳定优化过程；在晚期收敛阶段，引入创新的CHG-Shapley机制，利用样本难度（即局部训练损失）将更新投影到复合硬度-梯度空间，有效放大对抗性语义痕迹，即使在梯度范数消失时也能隔离隐蔽攻击者。此外，论文推导出CHG-Shapley的闭式解，实现了低复杂度、无需重训练的节点估值和信任调节聚合。在CIFAR-10、MedMNIST和NEU-SDDB数据集上的大量实验表明，Secure-CHG能有效缓解晚期失败问题：相比主流Krum和Trimmed Mean基线，显著抑制高级后门攻击，攻击成功率分别降低2.3倍和2.0倍。该研究为联邦学习安全提供了新视角，适合联邦学习研究人员、安全工程师及对机器学习鲁棒性感兴趣的读者阅读。

items.title: Off the Rails: Hijacking the Scoring Head in Generative End-to-End Driving Planners with Safety-Violating Adversarial Perturbations
items.summary: Generative models have recently seen rapid adoption in End-to-End (E2E) autonomous driving (AD), with diffusion-based denoising and vocabulary-based retrieval becoming the dominant trajectory-decoding paradigms. Despite their architectural diversity, current generative AD planners share a common inference pattern: a fixed set of candidate trajectories (anchors, vocabulary entries, or proposal queries) is scored by one or more learned heads conditioned on the Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, and the highest-scored candidate is returned as the final trajectory. Under this design, the scoring head is the only barrier between perception and the motion command, and its decision margins between competing candidates are often small. We introduce \textsc{Derail}, an adversarial framework that exploits this scoring-head attack surface. Evaluated on various generative planners, \textsc{Derail} flips the trajectory selection from a safe to an unsafe candidate, with score drops of $39$--$80\%$ and collision rates of up to $50\%$, consistently outperforming generic loss-maximization and feature-divergence attacks. Our analysis suggests that safety-violating objectives govern attack effectiveness against generative AD planners, and that the scoring-head inference pattern itself is a recurring attack surface worth explicit defensive consideration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器中的安全漏洞。当前主流的生成式规划器（如基于扩散去噪或词汇检索的）共享一个共同推理模式：固定候选轨迹集合（锚点、词汇条目或提议查询）由学习到的评分头部根据鸟瞰视图特征进行打分，最高分轨迹作为最终输出。评分头部成为感知与运动指令之间的唯一屏障，且竞争候选之间的决策边界往往很小。作者提出名为Derail的对抗框架，利用这一攻击面。在多种生成式规划器上的实验表明，Derail能够将轨迹选择从安全候选翻转为危险候选，分数下降39%–80%，碰撞率高达50%，性能持续优于通用损失最大化攻击和特征散度攻击。分析表明，违反安全的目标决定了攻击对生成式规划器的有效性，而评分头部的推理模式本身是一个值得明确防御考虑的反复出现的安全隐患。本文适合自动驾驶安全工程师、AI系统安全研究员以及端到端规划器开发者阅读。

items.title: Wireless Backdoor Attack and Defense for Semantic Communications over Multiple Access Channel
items.summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) aims to preserve semantic meaning and task-oriented information beyond conventional message recovery over wireless channels. The adoption of SemCom in shared-access wireless networks introduces new vulnerabilities for multi-user semantic inference. This paper considers a SemCom system for two transmitters communicating with a common receiver over a multiple access channel. Each transmitter maps source information into latent semantic representations, while the receiver jointly reconstructs and classifies the semantic information for both transmitters. A selective over-the-air backdoor (Trojan) attack is presented in which an adversary transmits a low-power trigger waveform over the air and injects it into the shared received signal during training. By transmitting the trigger again during testing, this stealthy, low-power attack selectively manipulates the semantic inference for one transmitter while minimally affecting the inference of the other transmitter. To mitigate this vulnerability, a trigger-aware defense mechanism is developed to preserve correct semantic labels under trigger-contaminated wireless observations. The results demonstrate both the vulnerability of shared-access SemCom systems to selective over-the-air backdoor attacks and the effectiveness of trigger-aware robust training for semantic protection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究多址接入信道（MAC）下语义通信（SemCom）系统的无线后门攻击与防御问题。语义通信旨在超越传统比特级恢复，保留语义信息和任务导向信息，在共享接入无线网络中具有重要前景。然而，共享接入环境引入了新的安全漏洞，特别是针对多用户语义推理的后门攻击。论文假设一个SemCom系统，两个发射器通过MAC向一个公共接收器通信。每个发射器将源信息映射为潜在语义表示，接收器联合重建和分类两个发射器的语义信息。作者提出一种选择性无线后门（特洛伊）攻击：在训练阶段，攻击者发射低功率触发波形，将其注入共享接收信号；在测试阶段，再次发射相同的触发，即可选择性地操纵其中一个发射器的语义推理结果，而对另一个发射器影响极小。该攻击具有隐蔽性和低功耗特性，难以被传统检测方法发现。为抵御此类攻击，论文提出一种触发感知的防御机制，通过在训练过程中引入触发污染的观测样本，进行鲁棒训练，从而在存在触发时仍能保持正确的语义标签。实验结果表明，共享接入SemCom系统容易受到选择性无线后门攻击，而触发感知的鲁棒训练能有效保护语义推理的完整性。本工作揭示了语义通信在物理层安全方面的新挑战，并为设计更安全的无线AI系统提供了思路。适合无线安全、AI安全以及语义通信领域的研究者阅读。

items.title: A Hybrid Framework For Crypto-Ransomware Detection In Enterprise Shared Storage
items.summary: Most corporate workplace environments enforce policies and technical controls that limit the storage of sensitive data on client endpoints. Consequently, ransomware operators have evolved variants that expand their attack surface from local systems to network drives and shared storage resources. As traditional endpoint detection mechanisms focus primarily on local system behaviour, a compromised client can impact remote file servers, such as by encrypting shared data, without directly triggering behavioural changes on the servers themselves. In this paper, we propose a hybrid detection framework for detecting crypto-ransomware intrusion within integrated file server and client environments. The framework is based on a new technique referred to as Region of Interest (RoI) to analyse network traffic and extract Indicators of Compromise (IoCs). The IoC repository serves as an additional ruleset to enhance existing security tools such as EDRs and IDSs, while RoI-derived features are used to train an ML model to detect highly evasive variants. This study incorporates a broader set of ransomwares families and carefully selected benign behaviors based on domain expertise, ensuring coverage of common user actions that could interfere with ransomware detection. Beyond IoCs, which operate in a signature-based manner, our machine learning module achieves a detection precision of 99.64%, with a 0% false negative rate (FNR) and a minimal false positive rate (FPR). Furthermore, the proposed method enables early detection, identifying ransomware intrusions before significant damage occurs, achieving an accuracy of 99.44%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对企业环境中勒索软件攻击向网络驱动器和共享存储扩展的趋势，提出了一种混合检测框架，用于检测集成文件服务器和客户端环境中的加密勒索软件入侵。该框架基于一种称为“感兴趣区域（RoI）”的新技术，通过分析网络流量提取入侵指标（IoC），并将IoC库作为额外规则集增强现有安全工具（如EDR和IDS）。同时，利用RoI特征训练机器学习模型，以检测高规避性变种。研究涵盖了更广泛的勒索软件家族，并基于领域专业知识精心选择了良性行为，确保覆盖可能干扰检测的常见用户操作。实验结果显示，机器学习模块实现了99.64%的检测精度，0%的假阴性率（FNR）和极低的假阳性率（FPR）。此外，该方法能够实现早期检测，在造成重大损害前识别勒索软件入侵，准确率达到99.44%。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究针对企业共享存储场景下传统端点检测的盲区，提出一种结合网络流量分析与机器学习的混合方法，显著提升对加密勒索软件的检测能力，尤其适用于重视数据安全的组织。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于企业文件服务器、网络附加存储（NAS）等共享存储环境，增强现有EDR/IDS的检测能力，减少勒索软件对关键数据的加密破坏。

items.title: A Multi-task Mixture of Experts Framework for Malware Classification, Packing Detection, and Family Attribution
items.summary: Malware classification remains a challenging problem due to its inherent heterogeneity, the presence of packed binaries, and the diverse distribution of malware families. Traditional single-model detection mechanisms often fail to generalize across such diverse data, leading to degraded performance, particularly on obfuscated and rare malware samples. In this work, we propose a unified multi-task malware analysis framework based on Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures. The proposed system evaluates performance across two different input representations, i.e., high-dimensional EMBER feature sets and raw 1D byte arrays extracted from Portable Executable files. It simultaneously performs three critical tasks: malware family classification, packed versus unpacked detection, and malware versus benign identification. By decomposing the problem into specialized expert networks and employing adaptive gating mechanisms, the model enables effective task-specific learning while maintaining overall scalability. We investigate multiple architectural variants, including Homogeneous MoE, Heterogeneous MoE, and Multi-Gate MoE (MMoE). Performance is evaluated in both standard and adversarial settings using original and mutated samples. The obtained results demonstrate that the Multi-Gate MoE model achieves the best performance, reaching a combined detection rate of 0.9744 with only $2.56\%$ failure rate. Moreover, this configuration exhibits improved robustness under mutation-induced distribution shifts. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of expert specialization and task-specific routing in handling complex malware distributions, making the proposed framework a promising direction for scalable and resilient malware detection systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对恶意软件分类中的异构性、加壳二进制文件以及恶意软件家族分布多样等挑战，提出了一种基于混合专家模型（Mixture of Experts, MoE）的统一多任务恶意软件分析框架。该框架同时执行三项关键任务：恶意软件家族分类、加壳/未加壳检测、恶意/良性识别。系统在两种输入表示上评估性能：高维EMBER特征集和从PE文件中提取的原始一维字节数组。通过将问题分解为专门的专家网络并采用自适应门控机制，模型实现了有效的任务特定学习，同时保持整体可扩展性。研究探讨了多种架构变体，包括同构MoE、异构MoE和多门控MoE（MMoE）。在标准环境和对抗性环境下（使用原始样本和变异样本）进行了性能评估。结果表明，多门控MoE模型取得了最佳性能，综合检测率达到0.9744，失败率仅为2.56%。此外，该配置在变异引起的分布偏移下表现出改进的鲁棒性。研究结果强调了专家专业化和任务特定路由在处理复杂恶意软件分布中的有效性，使所提出的框架成为可扩展且鲁棒的恶意软件检测系统的有前景方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种多任务学习结合MoE的框架，能同时检测加壳、分类家族和识别恶意软件，显著提升了对混淆和罕见样本的检测能力，为安全运营中构建单一模型解决多个检测任务提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方法可应用于恶意软件检测引擎的升级，尤其适用于处理加壳恶意软件和稀有家族样本；也可推广至其他需要多任务分类的网络安全场景。

items.title: CAN We Trust Your Results? A Cross-Dataset Study of Automotive IDS Evaluation
items.summary: The increasing connectivity of modern vehicles has made securing in-vehicle communication networks a critical challenge. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) have been widely studied as a defense mechanism for detecting malicious activities on the Controller Area Network (CAN) bus. However, the evaluation of CAN IDS methods remains difficult due to inconsistencies in experimental setups and the lack of standardized benchmarking frameworks. As a result, reported performance often depends on dataset-specific characteristics and may not reflect how detection methods behave in different environments. This work introduces a benchmarking framework for consistent evaluation of CAN IDSs across multiple datasets. Using the proposed framework, we integrate seven publicly available CAN IDS datasets collected under different experimental conditions and perform cross-dataset evaluation of five conceptually different IDS approaches. Our results highlight how detection performance can vary significantly across datasets, demonstrating the importance of cross-dataset benchmarking for assessing the robustness and generalization capabilities of CAN IDS methods.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于现代车辆控制器局域网（CAN）总线入侵检测系统（IDS）评估中的一致性问题。由于实验设置不一致且缺乏标准化基准，现有CAN IDS的性能评估往往依赖于特定数据集，导致结果难以泛化。为此，作者提出了一个跨数据集的统一基准框架，整合了七个在不同实验条件下公开的CAN IDS数据集，并基于该框架对五种概念上不同的IDS方法进行了交叉数据集评估。实验结果表明，检测性能在数据集间存在显著差异，凸显了跨数据集基准测试对于评估CAN IDS方法鲁棒性和泛化能力的重要性。该研究为CAN总线安全评估提供了方法论基础，有助于推动标准化评估体系的建立。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了CAN IDS评估中的数据集偏差问题，强调了跨数据集基准测试的必要性，对汽车安全研究者和实践者设计可靠IDS具有重要指导意义。

items.title: Proofs of Ownership for Machine Learning Models
items.summary: With the increasing adoption of Machine Learning, protecting model ownership has become an essential challenge. We initiate a formal study of Proof of Ownership for machine learning models: under what conditions can one prove that a stolen model originated from a particular creator? We model proofs of ownership as a game among three parties: a model owner, a thief, and a judge. The owner transforms the original model into a slightly perturbed model together with a proof of ownership. The thief then obtains the transformed model and attempts to minimally modify it so that it remains useful but escapes detection as owned by the model owner. Finally, the judge receives a model and a proof of ownership, and must decide whether the given model is a modified version of some model created by the model owner, or else the given model was developed independently. Our main result is a dichotomy for classifiers in the black-box setting: Under standard cryptographic assumptions, ownership of models for some concept class can be proven in the above sense {\em if and only if} the concept class is not self-correctable, in a sense close to that of Blum, Luby and Rubinfeld, STOC'90. The result is constructive and extends, with some variations, to a number of related settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着机器学习的广泛采用，保护模型所有权已成为关键挑战。本文首次对机器学习模型的“所有权证明”（Proof of Ownership）进行了形式化研究，探讨在何种条件下，模型被盗后可以证明其源自特定创建者。作者将问题建模为三方游戏：模型所有者（owner）、窃取者（thief）和法官（judge）。所有者将原始模型进行微小扰动，得到一个变换后的模型并附带所有权证明；窃取者获得变换模型后试图最小化修改以保持有用性但逃避检测；法官收到模型和证明后判断该模型是否为所有者创造模型的修改版本，或是独立开发的。主要结果是在黑盒设置下对分类器的一个二分法结论：在标准密码学假设下，对于某些概念类，模型所有权可证明当且仅当该概念类不是自校正的（self-correctable，类似于 Blum, Luby, Rubinfeld, STOC'90 的定义）。该结果是构造性的，并推广到多个相关设置（如灰盒设置、回归模型等）。本文为模型所有权保护提供了理论基础，并启发了新的防御方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文为机器学习模型的所有权验证提供了首个形式化框架和可证明安全保障，对保护知识产权、遏制模型盗用具有重要理论意义。安全从业者和AI治理人员应关注其后续应用。

items.title: Quantum Lazy Sampling and Path Recording for Any Group
items.summary: A central challenge in quantum algorithms and cryptography is reasoning about algorithms with oracle access to a random group element (e.g. a random function, permutation, or unitary). Can we efficiently simulate such algorithms? Can we determine what they know after t queries? A classical tool for this is lazy sampling: the oracle does not commit to the full group element upfront, but rather samples partial information about it on the fly. We study a quantum analog of lazy sampling: compressed oracles (or recording oracles). These are quantum data structures that allow on-the-fly simulation for quantum queries, originally introduced by Zhandry (CRYPTO '19) for random functions, and generalized to unitaries by Ma-Huang (STOC '25) and permutations by Carolan (STOC '26), and used to great effect in security proofs and lower bounds due to their interpretability. We define and analyze a general-purpose and interpretable path-recording oracle, derived from first principles, that perfectly simulates random elements of any closed subgroup of $U(N)$. Our oracle stores, in superposition, t input-output pairs, with updates described in terms of the commutant of the group's tensor power representation. This transparently records the information the algorithm has learned. Our oracle builds on recent work of Grinko-Yoshida (QIP '26), who gave a different general-purpose compressed oracle without clear interpretability. One interesting application of our path-recording is allowing direct comparisons between compressed oracles of different groups, giving a new technique for proving pseudorandomness results. For example, comparing $S_N$ and $U(N)$ yields what is arguably the simplest construction to date of pseudorandom unitaries: the product PC of a pseudorandom permutation and a random Clifford, improving on the prior PFC construction (Metger-Poremba-Sinha-Yuen, FOCS '24; Ma-Huang, STOC '25).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通用的路径记录预言机（path-recording oracle），用于高效模拟量子算法对任意闭子群随机群元素的查询访问。在量子算法与密码学中，算法常需对随机函数、置换或酉变换进行黑盒查询，经典做法是使用懒采样（lazy sampling）动态生成部分信息。量子环境下，Zhandry（CRYPTO '19）提出了压缩预言机（compressed oracle）用于随机函数，Ma-Huang（STOC '25）推广至酉变换，Carolan（STOC '26）推广至置换。这些预言机在安全证明和下界分析中作用显著，但其构造依赖于具体群结构，缺乏通用性。Grinko-Yoshida（QIP '26）给出了一个通用压缩预言机，但不可解释。本文从第一原理出发，定义并分析了一个可解释的路径记录预言机，能够完美模拟U(N)的任意闭子群中的随机元素。该预言机以叠加态存储t个输入-输出对，更新规则由群张量幂表示的交换子（commutant）描述，透明地记录了算法已学习的信息。此外，该预言机允许对不同群的压缩预言机进行直接比较，为证明伪随机性提供了新工具。例如，通过比较S_N和U(N)，可得到目前最简单的伪随机酉变换构造：将伪随机置换与随机Clifford门组合（PC构造），优于之前的PFC构造（Metger-Poremba-Sinha-Yuen, FOCS '24; Ma-Huang, STOC '25）。本文方法显著降低了构造的复杂性。

items.title: Defending Against Harmful Supervision Hidden in Benign Samples
items.summary: Existing defenses are effective when harmful content is explicitly mixed into downstream fine-tuning data, but crafted samples can instead hide harmful supervision inside benign tasks. We propose Embedded Attack, where harmful QA pairs are embedded within benign training samples, and show that representative guardrails often fail to detect them at the example level. To address this, we propose Dual-Reference SFT (DR-SFT), which adapts DPO-style contrastive objective design to SFT through token-level regularization, mitigating harmful fine-tuning beyond coarse data filtering.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型微调安全性的隐蔽威胁展开研究。现有防御机制通常假设有害内容以显式方式混入下游微调数据（例如直接包含恶意指令），但攻击者可以通过更精巧的方式将有害监督隐藏在看似良性的任务中。作者首先提出一种名为“嵌入攻击（Embedded Attack）”的方法，将有害问答对（如提供恶意行为指导的QA）嵌入到良性训练样本中，使得传统的基于示例级别的安全护栏（如内容过滤器）往往无法检测出这些隐藏的有害内容。实验表明，多种代表性护栏在示例级别检测这类攻击时均存在显著盲区。针对这一新型威胁，论文提出“双参考监督微调（Dual-Reference SFT，DR-SFT）”，该框架借鉴了DPO（直接偏好优化）中的对比目标设计思想，将其适配到监督微调解空间，通过引入令牌级别的正则化项来抑制模型从隐藏有害模式中学习。DR-SFT不依赖于粗粒度的数据过滤，而是从训练过程本身提供防御，能够有效降低模型在嵌入攻击下的有害倾向，同时保持良性任务的性能。主要贡献包括：1）首次系统研究隐蔽有害监督（隐藏于良性任务中的恶意样本）对微调安全性的影响；2）提出Embedded Attack作为评估此类威胁的基准；3）设计DR-SFT方法，从优化目标层面实现对比学习式的安全约束。该工作适合LLM安全研究人员、AI红蓝队以及模型微调工程师阅读，有助于理解从数据层面到训练层面的纵深防御需求。

items.title: An AI-Based Solution for Secure Service Provisioning in IoT
items.summary: As the Internet of Things (IoT) continues its rapid expansion, the attack surface grows accordingly, with emerging threats targeting smart objects and their interactions. In this evolving landscape, securing service provisioning is crucial to ensure the proper functioning, security, and reliability of the IoT ecosystem. Service provisioning encompasses key tasks such as device registration, configuration, authentication, authorization, and software deployment, all of which are essential for seamless and secure IoT operations. In this paper, we present a comprehensive framework designed to select the most suitable smart objects to deliver a target service within a given IoT environment while also monitoring the behavior of the entities involved during the service provisioning phase. To achieve this, we employ a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) approach in which an intelligent agent learns, through interaction with a complex, dynamic environment, how to adapt to changes while adhering to predefined security constraints. For behavioral monitoring, we leverage Federated Learning (FL) to develop a global Behavioral Fingerprinting (BF) model that is fully distributed and can analyze how IoT devices interact within the network. In addition, the BF is used to compute a reliability score for each service provider, reflecting its degree of compliance with the defined security constraints. This score is then incorporated into the service provisioning process, allowing smart objects to select providers not only according to functional suitability but also to their reliability level. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental evaluation to assess the robustness and scalability of our approach. The results demonstrate that our solution can be effectively deployed even on resource-constrained IoT devices, making it a viable and scalable security-enhancing mechanism for modern IoT ecosystems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对物联网（IoT）环境下服务提供过程中的安全问题，提出了一种基于人工智能的综合框架。随着IoT的快速发展，攻击面不断扩大，智能对象及其交互成为新的攻击目标。服务提供涉及设备注册、配置、认证、授权和软件部署等关键任务，其安全性对IoT生态系统的正常运行至关重要。该框架包含两个核心组件：一是基于深度强化学习（DRL）的智能代理，它通过与复杂动态环境的交互学习，在满足预定义安全约束的前提下，自适应地选择最合适的智能对象来交付目标服务；二是基于联邦学习（FL）的全局行为指纹（BF）模型，该模型完全分布式，能够分析IoT设备在网络中的交互行为。此外，行为指纹用于计算每个服务提供商的可靠度分数，反映其对安全约束的遵守程度。该分数被整合到服务选择过程中，使智能对象不仅根据功能适用性，还根据可靠度级别选择提供商。作者在资源受限的IoT设备上进行了广泛的实验评估，结果表明该方案具有鲁棒性和可扩展性，能够有效部署，为现代IoT生态系统提供了一种可行且可扩展的安全增强机制。

items.title: The Spectrum Strikes Back: Infrared POV Attacks on Traffic Sign Classification
items.summary: Traffic sign classification is a crucial task for autonomous vehicles, and numerous attacks against it have been identified. A majority of physical adversarial attacks involve attaching patches to traffic signs or projecting perturbations on them. While they demonstrate high effectiveness, they are perceptible to humans. At the same time, light-based attacks outside the human visible spectrum are known but have limitations in their dynamic adaptability. We propose a persistence-of-vision-based attack that operates in the near-infrared light spectrum. With the possibility of showing dynamic, remotely triggered content, this allows a stealthy physical adversarial attack against traffic sign classification. By identifying the optimal position through digital simulation, we conduct extensive real-world evaluations using two different traffic signs, 12 machine learning models from different families, multiple distances up to 20 meters, and varying illumination conditions. Our evaluation shows high attack success rates across our test scenarios. We propose near-infrared cutoff filters and a software-based detection mechanism as defenses, and tackle limitations of the near-infrared persistence of vision display by prototyping a human-visible RGB version of it.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种针对自动驾驶车辆交通标志分类系统的物理对抗攻击方法，利用近红外光谱和视觉暂留（Persistence of Vision, PoV）效应实现隐蔽攻击。现有物理攻击多采用贴纸或投影扰动，虽有效但易被人类察觉；而红外光攻击虽不可见但缺乏动态适应性。作者设计了一个基于近红外LED阵列的PoV显示器，可远程触发动态图案，投射到交通标志上以干扰分类模型。通过数字仿真确定最佳攻击位置，并在真实场景中测试了两种交通标志（Stop和Speed Limit）、12种不同架构的机器学习模型、距离最远20米以及多种光照条件。实验结果表明，该攻击在多数场景下具有高成功率。作为防御，作者提出了近红外截止滤光片和基于软件的检测机制（例如，通过分析图像中红外反射异常来识别攻击）。此外，他们还构建了可见光RGB版本的PoV显示器以解决近红外版本的局限性。该研究揭示了自动驾驶系统在物理域中面临的新型隐蔽威胁，为后续防御研究提供了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该攻击利用人眼不可见的红外光，实现了动态、远程触发的物理对抗样本，对自动驾驶交通标志识别系统的安全性构成严重威胁，且难以被常规方法检测。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响自动驾驶车辆的交通标志分类模块，可能导致车辆误判限速、停止等标志，进而引发安全事故。该攻击手法可迁移至其他依赖视觉传感器的嵌入式系统。
